jobs.title: Product Development Coordinator / Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Product Development Coordinator**

Pomona, CA (on-site)  
**Pay:** $25.00 – $35.00/hour, DOE (non-exempt) + bonus eligibility  
**Schedule:** Full-time

**About the Company**  
Our client is a well-established contract manufacturer of personal care, cosmetic, household, and consumer products. They have more than 30 years in business, around 400 employees across two manufacturing facilities, and they've roughly doubled in size over the past four years. With new investment behind them and continued expansion ahead, they're building out their team and investing in new systems, technology, and employee development. Employees describe the culture as family-oriented and people-first. Leadership is accessible and transparent, and there's a real emphasis on appreciation through company events, recognition programs, and community involvement.

**The Role**  
The Product Development Coordinator is the project quarterback for new and revised products, from the first customer inquiry through commercialization. You'll be the central point of coordination between Sales, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Production, making sure products move from concept to finished goods on time and within cost targets. You'll report to the Director of Project Management and partner directly with Sales and customers to bring wet wipe and filled products to market. This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and enjoys juggling multiple customer projects at once.

**What You'll Do**

*Project Coordination & Execution*

* Coordinate the full product development process, from the initial customer inquiry and questionnaire through production launch and handoff to commercialization.
* Execute each phase of development, including bill of materials, cost analysis, claims testing, prototype sample submission, and customer approval.
* Prioritize work across multiple concurrent projects, adjust workflows as needed, and track progress against the timelines committed to customers.
* Manage the transition from development to production, confirming that specs, BOMs, artwork, and component orders are finalized before the first production run.
* Maintain project documentation, including approvals, change requests, test results, and stage-gate milestones.

*Cross-Functional Liaison*

* Serve as the main point of contact across Sales, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Production throughout the development lifecycle.
* Keep Sales and customers informed with project updates, timelines, and status reports, and communicate risks or delays proactively.
* Contribute ideas for new product formats, packaging configurations, and formulation approaches.
* Partner with Regulatory/Compliance on ingredient reviews, labeling, and claims substantiation so products meet FDA, OTC monograph, and cosmetic regulations.

*Technical & Commercial Support*

* Determine packaging materials and sourcing requirements, including substrates, film structures, flow wrap and pouch formats, and component lead times.
* Keep product specifications, BOMs, and documentation accurate and current in the ERP system.
* Support customer-specific cost models and help prepare quotes in partnership with Sales and Finance.
* Review artwork and proofs with internal teams and customers so that components can be ordered on schedule.
* Apply your understanding of line capabilities, MOQs, changeover constraints, and material lead times to set realistic timelines.

**What You Bring**

* A bachelor's degree in Business, Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Packaging Science, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in project management, product development, or project coordination within the cosmetic, personal care, household, or CPG industry.
* Experience in a contract manufacturing (OEM) environment is strongly preferred, and manufacturing or production floor experience is a plus.
* A working understanding of packaging development, pouching and flow wrapping, formulation basics, manufacturing processes, and QA.
* Familiarity with FDA cosmetic and OTC monograph frameworks and with ingredient labeling is a plus.
* Strong Excel skills; experience with Salesforce, an ERP system (SAP, DEACOM, or similar), and project management tools is a plus.
* Strong organization and follow-through, an analytical, root-cause mindset, and confidence presenting project status to customers and leadership.
* A positive, adaptable approach and comfort in an environment where priorities shift and speed matters.

**Why You'll Love It**

* A growing company where new opportunities open up as the business expands.
* A collaborative, family-oriented culture with visible, approachable leadership.
* Regular employee appreciation events, recognition programs, and community giving.
* A growing investment in training and professional development.
* Exposure to a wide range of products and well-known brands.

**Work Environment**  
This is primarily an office-based role with occasional time on the manufacturing floor, where there is some exposure to fumes, airborne particles, moving mechanical parts, and vibration. The role involves occasional lifting of up to 20 lbs. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

The Lundquist Institute for Biomedical Innovation at Harbor-UCLA Medical Center (TLI) is Los Angeles County's preeminent independent, not-for-profit biomedical research hub, excelling in transforming scientific breakthroughs into practical therapies. With a $90 million annual budget, TLI is home to over 150 investigators and 500 staff, advancing 600 projects in areas such as Infection and Immunity, Cancer, and Women's Health. Founded in 1952, the Institute continues to train physician-scientists and manage healthcare programs for 60,000 underserved families throughout South Los Angeles.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Coordinate day-to-day administrative workflows for the Divisions of Infectious Diseases and Molecular Medicine under the direction of the Division Chiefs.
* Coordinate activities and follow up on assignments involving administrative support personnel as delegated by division leadership.
* Maintain clear escalation pathways, workflow documentation, and continuity of administrative operations.
* Serve as a central administrative contact for faculty, staff, trainees, and institutional offices;
* Route requests to the appropriate resource and follow up on unresolved matters.
* Prepare and distribute divisional announcements, reminders, operational notices, and other communications as directed.
* Coordinate recurring divisional research seminars, faculty meetings, candidate visits, and other meetings or events involving the divisions. Manage scheduling, room reservations, calendar invitations, audiovisual and virtual-meeting readiness, speaker or participant logistics, and approved travel arrangements. Prepare and distribute agendas, invitations, event materials, reminders, and follow-up communications. Provide on-site and virtual event support; coordinate approved food, transportation, lodging, and related services in accordance with institutional policies. Capture action items, confirm owners and deadlines assigned by division leadership, maintain tracking logs, and escalate items at risk of delay.
* Coordinate required evaluations, monitor completion, route materials to the appropriate institutional contact, and maintain records for internal reporting and faculty dossier support.
* Coordinate administrative steps associated with approved recruitment, hiring, onboarding, personnel changes, and offboarding in partnership with Human Resources and division leadership. Support job-posting requests, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and visit logistics. Collect, review for completeness, and route required forms and documentation, including applicable clearance and hospital-access materials. Coordinate administrative orientation and operational readiness for new employees, students, interns, and other trainees. Coordinate offboarding checklists, access changes, and return of institutional property with the responsible departments. Maintain appropriate confidentiality and promptly refer employee-relations matters to Human Resources and division leadership.
* Serve as the operational timekeeper and leave coordinator for assigned personnel in accordance with TLI and Harbor-UCLA requirements and delegated authority.
* Review timecards, punch corrections, and leave requests for accuracy and completeness; approve or route items for approval as authorized. Communicate submission deadlines and send timely reminders to employees and approvers. Research routine discrepancies with employees and coordinate resolution with Payroll, Human Resources, or other responsible offices. Maintain accurate records and escalate unresolved or time-sensitive issues to prevent payroll disruption.
* Prepare, route, and track purchase requisitions, purchase orders, blanket orders, reimbursements, and related documentation using institution-approved processes.
* Verify required supporting documentation, project or account information, and approvals; coordinate questions and discrepancy resolution with Purchasing, Accounting, Finance, and requestors. Maintain organized purchasing and reimbursement records and provide timely status updates. Coordinate office supplies, mail, checks, printing, scanning, copying, divisional phone coverage, and distribution or tracking of operational items such as lab coats. Submit and monitor service requests involving facilities, custodial services, information technology, badges, workspaces, office equipment, temperature, and audiovisual needs. Follow established emergency and safety-reporting procedures for workplace injuries, spills, or other urgent issues and promptly notify the appropriate safety personnel and division leadership.

**EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Three to four years in administrative field
* Ability to work independently when required
* Ability to work with diverse personalities.
* Ability to interact in an appropriate and professional manner
* Ability to work as a member of a team
* Ability to work well under pressure and meet multiple and sometimes conflicting deadlines
* Ability to interact in an appropriate and professional manner
* Demonstrated cooperative behavior and positive problem solving and conflict resolution skills

*Please ensure your application is complete and signed;* ***incomplete submissions will not be considered****.*

Background and Health Clearance Required

jobs.title: Client Experience Coordinator - FaithWise Advisors
jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Senior Client Experience Manager

**Position Summary:**  
The Client Experience Coordinator is an essential member of the FaithWise Advisors team, responsible for delivering the accurate, timely, and caring service that makes a high-touch client journey possible. This role supports every stage of the client relationship, from onboarding and account setup to contributions, grants, and ongoing service requests, ensuring each interaction reflects FaithWise's mission and its commitment to faithful stewardship.

The Coordinator partners with advisors, the Client Experience team, and operations colleagues to process client requests, maintain CRM discipline, and keep onboarding and business development workflows moving. After a structured training period, the Coordinator becomes a primary point of contact for clients, answering calls and emails with warmth, clarity, and discretion. Success in this role requires close attention to detail, sound judgment with sensitive information, and a daily commitment to FaithWise's values of integrity, stewardship, excellence, collaboration, and curiosity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Experience and Service Delivery**

* Answer client phone calls and emails promptly and professionally, resolving routine requests and setting clear expectations on next steps and timing.
* Process routine service requests, including address and contact updates, transfers, distributions, beneficiary and authorized-party changes, and document requests, and prepare forms for client signature.
* Prepare and process paperwork for donor-advised fund contributions and grant distributions, confirming documentation is complete before submitting for the Senior Client Experience Manager's review and approval.
* Prepare contribution receipts and acknowledgments and other standard client letters using approved templates.
* Coordinate with custodians, third-party administrators, Accounting, and advisors to complete requests, and follow up until each request is closed.
* Assemble and send client statements, custodian tax documents, and scheduled client communications according to the service calendar.
* Support stewardship touchpoints by scheduling outreach, preparing mailings, and tracking completion, in partnership with the CX Associate.
* Recognize requests that involve investment, tax, legal, or charitable-planning advice and route them promptly to the appropriate professional; escalate complex, sensitive, or time-critical matters to the Senior Client Experience Manager with a clear summary.

**Client Onboarding and Business Development Support**

* Carry out onboarding steps for new investing and charitable clients: send welcome communications, collect and review documents, prepare account-opening and fund-establishment paperwork, and track each item to completion.
* Follow up with clients, advisors, and custodians on missing or not-in-good-order items so accounts open on time.
* Maintain an onboarding tracker so the Senior Client Experience Manager and advisors can see the status of every new relationship at a glance.
* Enter and update client and prospect records and other information in the Redtail CRM and client files accurately and promptly, following FaithWise data standards, and keep contact records clean by correcting duplicates, gaps, and errors.
* Log client interactions, service activity, and prospect follow-up tasks in the CRM.
* Prepare materials for prospective client meetings, such as meeting packets, proposal documents, and follow-up letters, using approved templates and under the direction of the Senior Client Experience Manager and advisors.

**USGBC-CA Development Coordinator**

The Development Coordinator plays a vital role in advancing the mission of USGBC California by driving key operational, donor engagement, and business development functions across corporate sponsorships and individual giving. Reporting directly to the Chief Development Officer, this role executes sponsorship fulfillment across 10 California regions, coordinates logistics for signature fundraising events (California Green Building Conference and Green Gala), manages individual giving appeals, and supports business development for leading market initiatives. Embracing our core values of being "Rooted in Kindness" and "Humans in Service to One Another," this position ensures seamless donor stewardship and database management to support annual funding goals while building lasting relationships with both current and future partners.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

* **Fundraising Execution & Support:** Coordinate fundraising identification, cultivation, asks, stewardship fulfillment, and benefit tracking across fundraising initiatives, including statewide and regional funding.
* **Signature Event Fundraising Logistics:** Support event fundraising execution for statewide and regional events (ex. California Green Building Conference, Green Gala, etc.), coordinating sponsor collateral, benefit execution, and post-event funder follow-up.
* **Campaign Execution:** Coordinate administrative and digital workflows for giving programs, market transformation initiatives, and events utilizing automations and tech stack (monday, mail merge, Donorbox, etc.)
* **CRM Management & Funder Stewardship:** Coordinate and maintain strong funder data (ex. Copper CRM), process incoming gifts, run targeted appeal queries, and issue timely acknowledgment letters and tax receipts.
* **Business and Partnership Development:** Actively build relationships with both current and potential future partners, with a focus on how to implement initiatives and programs that transform the real estate industry.
* **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:** Act in service to the broader team by pulling collateral, gathering funder metrics, and supporting cross-functional initiatives with a "how can I help?" mindset.
* Other duties as assigned

**Success in this role looks like**

* **Creative Thinking:** Generate original ideas and propose innovative solutions anchored in fundraising best practices; proactively reach out to colleagues to brainstorm when encountering challenges; value diverse perspectives.
* **Time Management & Prioritization:** Plan and manage work deliverables efficiently maximizing effectiveness, coordinate multiple fundraising priorities and deadlines, and keep leadership informed while escalating potential conflicts proactively.
* **Team Mentality:** Understand organizational priorities and cross-functional workflows to support colleagues in reaching their goals without creating operational bottlenecks.
* **Empathy:** Seek to understand the needs of funders, members, and teammates, fostering compassion, awareness, and respect in every interaction.
* **Results Orientation:** Take personal responsibility for driving outcomes, maintaining flexibility and focus to adapt to new challenges and achieve funding targets.

**Qualifications/Skills**

* **Experience:** 2–3 years of hands-on fundraising, donor relations, or event sponsorship coordination experience required.
* **Technical Literacy:** Proficiency with nonprofit CRM systems and automations (Copper/Raiser's Edge), project management software, and digital marketing platforms required.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills for drafting compelling funder appeals, sponsor correspondence, and impact updates.
* **Mission & Values Alignment:** Strong dedication to climate action and sustainability, paired with a spirit of open collaboration, warmth, and active listening.

**Work Requirements**

* **Travel:** Occasional statewide travel required for major conferences, galas, and community events.
* **Physical/Mental Requirements:** Safely lift and transport event materials up to 25 lbs; stand or walk for extended intervals during events; maintain focus and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**TIME COMMITMENT & COMPENSATION:**

This is a full-time, hybrid position. Location: Los Angeles. Annual salary range is $65,000-$75,000.

We offer a full benefits package with discretionary unlimited vacation, 14 paid holidays, healthcare coverage (including vision and dental), 401k, and life insurance. We have parental leave and offer an annual bonus program while working in a flexible, hybrid structure.

Staff has the availability to attend our trainings and other industry events in our network and we also offer reimbursement for continuing education. We strive to have a work-life balance where we work to live and have regular team-building events to maintain our culture.

**ABOUT USGBC California:**

USGBC-CA is about people – Passionate, practical, and informed professionals and advocates who work together to transform California into a more sustainable region for all. USGBC-CA is the best place for anyone to learn the “why”, “who” and “how” of living sustainably, because business, as usual, is no longer an option. Volunteers and members believe in a sustainable built environment, gaining education, being exposed to innovation, and taking impactful action.

jobs.title: Jr Account Manager

**About Us**  
At Vector Media, we’re building the future of Mobility Marketing, where media moves with people, meets them in real life, and makes a lasting impression.  
  
In an advertising world cluttered with screens and scrolls, we deliver real-world media with real results. From digital bus shelters and street-level storytelling to experiential activations, college campus and sports partnerships, we connect brands with audiences in the moments that matter most.

Founded in 1998, Vector has grown from an OOH disruptor into a full-service platform built on data, creativity, and movement. We call it Marketing in Motion, an approach that blends storytelling and strategy to drive results across every channel we touch.  
  
But what truly sets us apart is how we show up: as partners. With our clients. With our media partners. With each other. Through accountability, innovation, and shared ambition, we’re helping brands do more than reach people, we’re helping them move people.

jobs.title: Inclusion Concierge Program Specialist (Circles of Support & Disability Services)
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

This position is grant-funded for an initial 18-month term. The Kelsey may seek continued funding for the position, but employment beyond 18 months is not guaranteed.

The Inclusion Concierge Program Specialist brings specialized disability expertise to The Kelsey’s Resident Services program, grounded in experience supporting adults with a range of disabilities and support needs, including people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). A primary focus of this role is launching and strengthening The Kelsey’s Circles of Support practice for residents with higher or more complex support needs, co-facilitating Circles alongside Inclusion Concierge to strengthen residents’ natural and formal supports while centering their goals, choices, and self-determination.

The Program Specialist also serves as a disability services and benefits resource for residents and the Inclusion Concierge team, bringing deeper knowledge of disability systems, benefits, services, and community resources when more specialized support is needed. They will help strengthen disability-forward practice across Resident Services by sharing their expertise and developing practical tools, resources, and training that support current Inclusion Concierges and can be carried forward as The Kelsey opens new communities.

For this role, you will:

**Launch & Co-Facilitate Circles of Support**

* Lead the implementation and ongoing development of The Kelsey’s Circles of Support practice, incorporating input from residents and people with lived experience of disability, with a focus on residents with higher or more complex support needs.
* Partner with Inclusion Concierge to identify residents who may benefit from a facilitated Circle of Support and co-facilitate the process alongside the resident’s IC.
* Help residents identify, build, and strengthen their Circle of Support, including family, friends, neighbors, community connections, service providers, and others the resident chooses to involve.
* Facilitate accessible, resident-directed Circle conversations that keep the resident’s goals, preferences, communication needs, choices, and self-determination at the center while helping their network strengthen communication and work toward resident-identified goals
* Use Circles proactively to identify gaps in support, strengthen natural supports that complement formal and paid services, reduce isolation, foster interdependence, and build stronger networks that contribute to residents’ well-being and housing stability.
* Develop practical tools and processes for documenting, revisiting, and strengthening Circles so the practice can be sustained and expanded across current and future Kelsey communities.

**Provide Disability-Forward Expertise & Specialized Support**

* Bring specialized knowledge and experience in disability-forward support, with particular expertise in supporting adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD).
* Work alongside residents and their Inclusion Concierge when more specialized disability expertise would strengthen support, while the IC remains the resident’s primary Resident Services contact.
* Bring person-centered and disability-forward practices—including self-determination, supported decision-making, dignity of risk, natural supports, and interdependence—to resident support and planning.
* Help residents and ICs navigate more complex support needs, including identifying gaps in existing supports and exploring additional formal or natural supports that align with the resident’s goals and preferences.
* Participate in resident case conferences and other collaborative planning as needed, bringing disability-specific knowledge and helping identify when needs are best addressed by outside providers or services.

**Strengthen Benefits & Disability Systems Navigation**

* Maintain strong, current knowledge of benefits, services, and systems available to adults with disabilities locally, regionally, statewide, and federally, including Regional Center services, IHSS, SSI/SSDI, Medi-Cal and Medicare, HCBS, transportation, employment supports, and other disability-specific resources.
* Help residents understand and navigate benefits and services they may be eligible for, particularly when needs are complex, services are interrupted, or additional support is needed beyond a routine referral.
* Serve as a resource to Inclusion Concierge when deeper systems knowledge is needed, helping identify additional options and pathways while ICs continue to make referrals and maintain ongoing relationships with residents and their service partners.
* Build relationships with disability organizations, public agencies, Regional Centers, benefits resources, service providers, and other community partners to stay connected to available resources and emerging opportunities for residents.
* Develop and maintain practical benefits and resource information that can be used by residents and Inclusion Concierge across The Kelsey’s communities.

**Strengthen & Share Disability-Forward Inclusion Concierge Practice**

* Translate lessons from Circles of Support, disability services navigation, and direct resident work into practical tools and resources that strengthen The Kelsey’s Resident Services program, including a clear, replicable framework that other inclusive communities can adapt.
* Support recruitment, training, and retention of volunteers who support Resident Services programming and residents across The Kelsey’s communities, building a pipeline for future growth.
* Partner with Resident Services leadership to identify opportunities to deepen disability-forward practices and incorporate effective approaches into the broader Inclusion Concierge model.
* Develop and support training for current and new Inclusion Concierges on Circles of Support, disability services and systems, person-centered support, and other disability-forward practices.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Associate
jobs.description:
### **About Subsense**

Subsense is a deep-tech company developing the world’s first non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI - starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.

**About Subsense**

Subsense is building an AI-native NanoBCI: a non-surgical brain-computer interface that uses nanoparticles instead of implants. We are about 40 scientists and engineers across two Bay Area labs, starting with medical applications such as Parkinson's and ALS. Our marketing team runs conferences, PR, investor materials, events and our social presence, and the pace is high.

**The role**

You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. In a typical month our marketing team tracks 10 or more conference deadlines, a weekly PR agency cycle, several vendors, lab visits, filming days and investor requests, all at once.

You will own the system that holds all of it: one source of truth for deadlines, owners and status. You will close loops before anyone has to ask. This is a contract-to-hire position based on performance.

### **What you will do**

* **Deadline and task system:** run our marketing task board and calendar, track every deadline, send reminders a week and a day ahead, flag risks early
* **Conferences:** research and shortlist conferences, prepare and submit applications, abstracts and speaker nominations, handle registration, travel and sponsor paperwork (SfN, NYBCI, IEEE Brain, BCI Society, Milken and more)
* **PR agency management:** join the weekly call with PR agency, track action items, check delivered work against the agreed scope, keep invoices on time
* **Scheduling:** book meetings across internal teams, speakers, partners and vendors; prepare agendas and send follow-ups
* **Vendors and paperwork:** route NDAs and contracts, collect quotes, track invoices and expenses, keep files organized in the shared drive
* **Events and visits:** logistics for lab tours, filming days, panels and our annual Forum (speaker travel, catering, venue, RSVPs, thank-you notes, photo delivery)
* **Reporting:** keep a weekly status update for Alex

### **You might be a fit if you**

* Love closing tasks and feel calm when a list is long
* Have 1 to 3 years in operations, events, executive assistance, or agency coordination
* Prioritize well: you can tell what matters today versus what can wait, and you explain why
* Communicate clearly, directly, and think outside the box to find solutions
* Live in Notion, monday.com, Asana or similar, plus Google Workspace, Slack and calendars
* Use AI tools actively to work faster and smarter (summaries, drafts, research) and still check the details
* Live in the Bay Area and can be on-site most days

**Nice to have**

* Experience in biotech, medtech, deep tech or a startup
* Conference or trade show logistics
* Event planning or PR agency background

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a short note on the most complex thing you have kept organized. Shortlisted candidates complete three short test tasks and present them in a Loom before the first interview.

### **Why You’ll Thrive**

You'd be joining a small team developing a non-surgical, bidirectional brain-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. You’ll help translate early research into working technology, with the opportunity to influence both the platform and how we build it.

**A few things that make this different:**

* **Own meaningful technical work:** Take projects from early R&D through functional prototypes, with room to test ideas, solve complex problems, and shape design decisions.
* **Build across disciplines:** Work hands-on with ultrasound, electronics, and instrumentation alongside scientists and engineers in neuroscience, nanotechnology, and AI.
* **Help shape a novel platform:** Contribute to technology with the potential to restore neurological function and, over time, enable direct brain-to-AI communication.
* **Make a visible impact:** Join a team where your contributions directly influence technical progress, with equity that lets you share in the company’s growth.

Our work takes place across labs in Palo Alto and Mountain View. We offer a competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), commuter benefits, and paid time off.

*Subsense is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

**Position Type:** Full-time, permanent, benefits-eligible (at-will employment)

jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

**About the team**
------------------

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales. It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward. If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

**What you'll do**

Airwallex is looking for an Account Manager to manage and grow a substantial portfolio of US-based small and medium customers. You will build trusted relationships with founders, CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders while helping customers maximize the value of Airwallex's global financial platform.

You will use customer insight, product knowledge, and account data to increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and support smooth ongoing operations. * 4+ years of account management or software sales experience in technology, SaaS, fintech, payments, or a related industry.
* Strong sales skills, including value-based solution selling, commercial judgment, and the ability to navigate complex sales cycles.
* Demonstrated success managing a substantial book of business and driving revenue growth through account expansion, upselling, cross-selling, or product adoption.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to build trust and present effectively to CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Outbound (Hybrid - SF)
jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This is a high-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

It is a focused top-of-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full-cycle sales role.

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection-handling, and territory-management skills before furthering their sales career.

***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in San Francisco, CA)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow-ups, account research, and multi-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability - you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative - you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

**What success looks like**

In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling - whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market role.

**Why join Rippling**

* You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies - not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more
* You’ll join a fast-paced, high-performance sales environment with strong coaching, clear goals, and room to grow
* You’ll be part of a collaborative SDR team that values healthy competition, accountability, and continuous improvement
You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data

jobs.description:
Project Coordinator

Swoon Spaces · Luxury Home Organization and Home Concierge

Location: New York City and New Jersey

Type: Freelance, booked by the session

Pay: $22 to $28 per hour, based on experience

Bringing you from chaos to calm.

Love a beautifully styled shelf, a perfectly folded stack and a closet that finally makes sense? Join Swoon Spaces as a Project Coordinator and help bring calm to beautiful homes, one session at a time. No organizing experience needed. We train you.

About Swoon Spaces

Swoon Spaces is a luxury home organization and home concierge company with teams in New York City and New Jersey, Los Angeles and Austin. We step into our clients' closets, kitchens, pantries, nurseries and every space in between, and leave behind calm, beauty and systems that last. Every session is guided by a lead organizer and supported by a small, close team.

The Role

As a Project Coordinator, you support the lead organizer, the client and the team so every session moves the project forward. You help contain the chaos, protect the client experience and keep the work moving from arrival through closeout.

What You'll Do

In the home

- Empty drawers, shelves, cabinets and closets, then sort like with like into clear categories.

- Keep categories clearly separated (keep, donate, trash, return and relocate), labeling temporary piles with sticky notes.

- Fold, switch out hangers and color code under the lead's direction.

- Unpack and prepare product, then place items and create labels once the lead approves the system.

- Wipe surfaces before items go back, then reset the space for photos and the client walkthrough.

Behind the scenes

- Pick up product orders from The Container Store and other approved stores.

- Return unused product and drop off donations at approved locations.

With the team

- Follow the lead's plan, and bring questions about product, scope, timing or client decisions to the lead.

- Look for the next useful task the moment one is complete.

- Represent Swoon with warmth, discretion and polish in every home.

Who You Are

- Design minded. Inspired by aesthetics and the feeling of a beautifully finished space.

- Detail oriented. You notice the label a hair off center and the hanger facing the wrong way.

- Fast and focused through a full day of hands on work.

- Ready for physical work: long days on your feet, lifting boxes, using ladders and working in tight closets.

- Warm and discreet with clients, including in their most private spaces.

- Able to read the room, aware of tone, body language and client energy.

- Coachable, welcoming feedback with a calm, positive attitude.

- Reliable: on time, prepared and polished, and quick to communicate when plans change.

- Comfortable using Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs and Google Sheets) and your smartphone.

Experience in organizing, interior design, styling, home staging, visual merchandising, move management, hospitality or luxury retail is a lovely bonus, but never a requirement.

Schedule

- Freelance and booked by the session, so you choose the sessions that fit your week.

- Most sessions are 6 to 8 hours long.

- Paid hourly for the sessions you book.

How to Apply

Email careers@swoonspaces.com with the subject line "Project Coordinator: NYC/NJ" and include:

- A short note on why organizing makes your heart happy.

- Your resume or a summary of your experience.

- Your general availability.

- A few photos of spaces you have organized or styled, if you have them.

Questions are always welcome at the same address.

Swoon Spaces welcomes applicants of every background and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by law.

Pay: $22.00 - $28.00 per hour

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

Work Location: In person

John Jay College of Criminal Justice is a senior college of the City University of New York (CUNY) and an internationally recognized leader in educating for justice. Led by President Karol V. Mason, John Jay is a federally designated Hispanic-serving institution, it is ranked third in the nation in Black student success, and it is a top ten institution for promoting student social mobility. **Overview:**

The Andrew Carnegie Foundation, originally established as Carnegie Corporation of New York, was founded in 1911 by Andrew Carnegie. Today, our funding supports the issues that Carnegie considered most important: education, democracy, and peace.

Our grantmaking is grounded in Andrew Carnegie’s vision to do “real and permanent good in the world.”

**About the International Program:**

The International Program is rooted in Andrew Carnegie’s founding vision - to advance peace as both the absence of armed conflict and the creation of conditions that sustain nonviolent growth and change. In an era of multidimensional crises - ranging from wars and migration pressures to disruptive technologies. The program seeks to catalyze peace through integrated, evidence-based approaches that bridge knowledge and action.

**Position Summary:**

The Operations Coordinator will report to and provide administrative support to the Vice President and coordinate all international program department-wide activities. The ideal candidate will be proactive, curious, detail oriented, and possess knowledge of, or interest in international affairs.

**Responsibilities:**

* Assist the vice president in departmental management, planning and communication.

* Process invoices and consultant contracts.
* Maintain organized, accurate program files and records.

* Serve as point of contact to coordinate onboarding of new international program staff.

**Skills:**

* Excellentorganizational and interpersonal skills.

* Discretion; initiative; flexibility, and good judgment.

Bloomberg is a global leader in business and financial information, news and insight, and we use innovative technology to deliver trusted data and bring transparency to the financial markets. Our customers around the globe rely on us for the information and tools they need to make critical investment decisions and remain connected across all sides of the financial community. And, to ensure the best experience for our 20,000+ employees across 176 offices globally, we provide the spaces and systems that allow our teams to work together with agility, productivity and collaboration, no matter where they are.

  
  

The Bloomberg Financial Solutions department of 5,000+ employees is at the forefront of ensuring success for our customers and employees alike. Our team comprises several key pillars: sales, service, operations, culture and brand. As a department, we are united by a common goal: We create meaningful relationships with clients by understanding their needs and delivering exceptional end-to-end support from sales and implementation, through their ongoing relationship with Bloomberg.

As a Senior Account Manager in Core Terminal Sales team, based in New York, you’ll cover leading financial markets institutions leveraging the product at the center of our business, the Bloomberg Terminal. You’ll develop a deep understanding of your clients’ workflows, technology, and data landscape, and use that context to deliver solutions that stick. You’ll build senior relationships that strengthen long-term partnerships and ensure Bloomberg remains embedded in how clients work.

  
  

You’ll be responsible for protecting and expanding existing client partnerships by defending renewals and competitive situations, while also building a healthy pipeline through disciplined lead sourcing. You will partner closely with Relationship Managers, Product Specialists, and Specialist Sales teams to execute account strategies and contribute to the broader success of our clients, team, and business.

  
  

**We’ll trust you to:**

  

* Develop deep, trusted relationships across your client base, from end users through desk heads and senior decision makers, to understand priorities, demonstrate Bloomberg’s value and protect existing revenue

* Build a strong understanding of your clients’ roles, workflows and business needs, using thoughtful questioning to identify gaps and position relevant Bloomberg functionality and solutions that deepen product adoption

* Take a strategic view across your account coverage to identify opportunities to expand Bloomberg’s footprint across Terminal, Enterprise products and data solutions

* Partner closely with Relationship Managers, product specialists and Enterprise teams to qualify opportunities, develop account strategies and progress revenue opportunities with key stakeholders and decision makers

* Develop deep expertise in Bloomberg’s solutions, financial markets and client segments, applying that knowledge to help clients optimize their workflows and identify opportunities where Bloomberg can provide additional value

* Proactively identify risks and opportunities across your accounts, including competitive threats, underutilized solutions and client needs that could inform product enhancements or create new commercial opportunities

* Contribute beyond your day-to-day account responsibilities by sharing successful strategies and best practices, supporting broader sales and departmental initiatives, mentoring colleagues, leading campaigns and contributing to product development

  
  

**You’ll need to have:**

  

* Experience in Account Management or a Sales-related role, supporting financial services clients

* Proven consultative sales skills, including competitive market research, lead generation, prospecting, business development and closing sales

* Experience in building and maintaining client relationships both externally and internally

* Strong presentation and communication skills

* Experience in one or more of the following asset classes: Fixed Income, Equities, FX, Futures, and other Derivatives

* The ability for regular travel

  
  

**We’d love to see:**

  

* Prior experience or knowledge of the Bloomberg product suite.

  
  

**What’s it like to work here?**

  

We work hard. We are ambitious and set ourselves tough business goals. We are a meritocracy where everyone has a voice - not a job title. Working with people you trust, respect, and can collaborate with is more important than titles or position. Things move fast, and we want people who will enjoy working in this environment and feed off the energy. But it isn’t all about work. Giving back is one of our core values, and there are many ways to get involved in philanthropic initiatives from helping local school kids with their reading to helping clean up local parks and waterways.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Ads helps advertisers reach customers at scale through full-funnel advertising across Prime Video & Amazon MGM Studios, Twitch, Fire TV, Amazon Music, Wondery, Alexa, Amazon.com, third-party supply, and everything in between. We use trillions of first-party streaming, browsing, and shopping signals with machine learning to make campaigns more efficient. Our measurement tools give advertisers a clear picture of their impact wherever customers are.  
  
The Supply Integrations team works with global supply sources to give Amazon Demand-Side Platform (DSP) customers access to third-party inventory. We manage partnerships with supply-side platforms (SSPs), strategic publishers, and data vendors, building joint product roadmaps that benefit our mutual customers. We handle supply-source integrations from activation through ongoing health monitoring, run payment operations, and keep programmatic sources accountable to efficiency metrics.  
  
We are looking for an Account Manager who enjoys working at the intersection of advertising, technology, and partner management. In this role you will own day-to-day partner relationships while pushing supply quality, new-format launches, and optimizations that directly improve results for Amazon advertisers. If you like untangling cross-functional problems in a fast-moving environment and want to help shape how programmatic supply works, we would love to talk to you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own and grow relationships with SSP partners, strategic publishers, and data vendors — act as their primary contact and build recommendations that improve both partner and advertiser results.
* Run end-to-end onboarding of new supply partnerships alongside Product, Engineering, and Solutions Architecture teams, from technical integration kick-off through go-live validation.
* Track supply quality and dig into performance data so third-party inventory keeps delivering real value for Amazon advertisers; update account plans when business conditions shift.
* Launch new formats (e.g., Audio, Digital Out-of-Home, mobile app, live events), bring marketplace feedback back to the team, and work cross-functionally to shape program direction.
* Handle payment and invoicing operations for supply partners, spot process improvements, and use generative AI tools where they make sense to scale reporting and cut manual work.

  
A day in the life  
Most mornings you will check partner performance dashboards and triage any integration issues before hopping into cross-functional syncs with Product and Engineering. You will spend a good chunk of your time on partner calls — talking through optimization opportunities, troubleshooting delivery gaps, or mapping out new-format launches. Between meetings you will pull data to build account plans and put together business reviews. You will also block off time for your own analysis, writing up recommendations, and adding to shared playbooks that help the rest of the team work smarter.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Ads helps brands and agencies reach customers through one of the world's largest programmatic advertising platforms. Amazon DSP runs campaigns across Video, Audio, and Display on Amazon-owned properties and tens of thousands of third-party websites and apps. The Supply Integrations team makes sure our global network of SSPs, publishers, and data vendors delivers reliable, high-quality inventory to advertisers. We run a subject-matter-expert model across verticals like Audio, Digital Out-of-Home, mobile app, and strategic publishers, so each team member gets the chance to become the go-to person in their area. We are investing in scalable tools, automation, and new formats that will shape how programmatic supply works going forward, and we want people who are excited to build alongside us.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Experience in optimizing products and services based on client needs
* Experience in e-commerce or online advertising
* Experience reviewing and analyzing performance metrics to identify areas of opportunity that will drive performance improvement
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA
* Experience in omni-channel marketing, search engine marketing or search engine optimization
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

**About the team**
------------------

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales. It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward. If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

**What you'll do**

Airwallex is looking for an Account Manager to manage and grow a substantial portfolio of US-based small and medium customers. You will build trusted relationships with founders, CFOs, CEOs, and other senior stakeholders while helping customers maximize the value of Airwallex's global financial platform.

You will use customer insight, product knowledge, and account data to increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and support smooth ongoing operations. A Business Development Representative (BDR) will be responsible for creating new sales opportunities for Cents. BDR's will research laundromats in their assigned territory, create an outreach plan and determine how laundromats can benefit from leveraging Cents’ all-in-one digital platform. ### **Qualifications**

* 1+ year of professional B2B experience, preferably in vertical SMB SaaS.

The salary range listed reflects the base pay for this role in New York City, and actual compensation may vary based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Cents is a New York-based technology company building the leading platform for the $40+ billion laundry and dry cleaning industry, helping laundromats, dry cleaners, and garment care businesses start, manage, and grow. jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Liberty Leaf is hiring a Cannabis Sales Representative to manage and grow the Brooklyn & Staten Island New York territory. This is a high-impact, field-based role responsible for driving revenue, developing new business, strengthening retail partnerships, and expanding our wholesale footprint across licensed dispensaries.

You will take ownership of your territory from prospecting through sell-through, including opening new accounts, growing existing relationships, driving reorders, and executing at retail while representing Liberty Leaf’s portfolio of brands: To The Moon, Flav, and Munchkins.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of professional field sales, territory sales, or account management experience
* Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales goals and developing long-term customer relationships
* Experience independently managing a territory, pipeline, or book of business
* Self-directed and comfortable managing priorities independently in a field-based environment
* Strong communication, negotiation, organization, and follow-up skills
* Proven ability to prospect, develop new business, and convert opportunities into active accounts
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation
* Ability to travel regularly throughout Brooklyn & Staten Island, with periodic travel to our Brooklyn office

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cannabis, CPG, beverage, lifestyle, or other regulated-industry sales experience
* Existing relationships with licensed New York dispensaries
* Knowledge of the New York cannabis market and competitive landscape
* Familiarity with wholesale sales platforms, CRM systems, or account-management tools

**Core Responsibilities**

* Develop and manage relationships with licensed dispensaries across the assigned territory
* Prospect, develop, and close new wholesale accounts
* Conduct in-person sales visits to educate buyers and staff on product offerings and brand positioning
* Identify and pursue pricing, promotional, and placement opportunities in coordination with leadership
* Monitor sell-through and account performance to drive reorders and growth
* Maintain consistent follow-up with accounts to support orders, resolve needs, and identify additional sales opportunities
* Analyze sales data and market trends to inform territory strategy
* Maintain awareness of competitive products, pricing, promotions, and market activity
* Partner with marketing and operations to support merchandising, activations, and retail rollouts
* Maintain accurate pipeline tracking and territory reporting
* Represent Liberty Leaf professionally across all retail environments

**Why Join Liberty Leaf**

This role offers the opportunity to take real ownership of a New York sales territory while representing a growing portfolio of cannabis brands.

You’ll work closely with leadership, directly influence revenue and retail expansion, and have the autonomy to build account relationships and shape your territory strategy.

We value initiative, accountability, strong relationships, thoughtful decision-making, and a consistent focus on results.

**Compensation & Schedule**

Estimated total annual compensation: $75,000–$95,000, depending on sales performance and experience. Final compensation will be based on experience.

This is a full-time, field-based position requiring a minimum of 40 hours per week. While the majority of business is conducted Monday through Friday, flexibility is required based on retailer schedules, activations, and territory needs. Some Saturday work will be required, with scheduling coordinated in advance.

**What Success Looks Like**

Successful representatives at Liberty Leaf take ownership of their territory, build strong retail relationships, and consistently look for opportunities to grow the business.

*Drives Results*

* Consistently works to meet or exceed revenue, distribution, and reorder goals
* Identifies new opportunities and converts prospects into active, growing accounts

*Takes Ownership*

* Proactively manages prospecting, account visits, follow-ups, merchandising, and territory priorities
* Operates independently, communicates proactively, and follows through on commitments

*Builds Strong Relationships*

* Develops trusted relationships with buyers, managers, and retail teams
* Supports long-term account growth through product education, merchandising, activations, and consistent follow-up

*Resilient & Adaptable*

* Handles objections, competitive pressure, and slower sales periods without losing momentum
* Uses sales data, market knowledge, and sound judgment to adjust strategy and prioritize opportunities

Pay: $75,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Mileage reimbursement
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Will you be able to reliably commute to Brooklyn and Staten Island, NY for this job?
* Do you have reliable transportation?
* Why are you interested in this position?

Experience:

* Sales: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Associate
jobs.description:
Astro Gallery of Gems is seeking a creative, detail-oriented E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Associate to support our online presence across our website, social media channels, digital advertising campaigns, and third-party sales platforms.

This role combines product e-commerce merchandising, digital design, paid advertising management, and digital content creation. The ideal candidate will be skilled in digital graphic design, working in e-commerce platforms like Shopify, executing marketing campaigns using tools like Klaviyo, and developing compelling digital content that showcases unique gems, minerals, fossils, and natural history specimens.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Advertising & Email Marketing**

Create, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, and Square.

Design, write, and deploy targeted email marketing campaigns and automated flows using tools such as Klaviyo and Canva.

Track performance metrics and report on ROAS, engagement, and conversion rates across advertising and email channels.

**Website Content Development**

Develop and maintain engaging product and editorial content for the Astro Gallery website.

Upload and manage product photography, video, descriptions, and other digital assets.

Assist with website merchandising, product organization, collections, and promotional updates.

Design visually appealing web assets, banners, and digital collateral tailored for e-commerce and brand promotions.

Contribute ideas for improving the online customer experience and product presentation.

**Social Media & Digital Content**

Develop and maintain content for social media platforms.

Create graphics, captions, and other engaging content highlighting products, collections, exhibitions, events, and the world of gems and minerals.

Help develop a consistent visual identity and voice across digital channels.

Collaborate on content calendars and campaigns.

Monitor social trends and identify opportunities to increase engagement and reach.

**Third-Party Sales Platforms**

Coordinate product uploads and promotional updates

Monitor listings and assist with resolving content or inventory issues.

Learn and adapt to the requirements and best practices of each sales platform.

**Qualifications & Skills**

Experience with e-commerce, digital merchandising, content creation, photography, or a related field.

Hands-on experience managing and maintaining e-commerce platforms, specifically Shopify, as well as third-party online marketplaces.

Strong written communication skills.

Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, inventory databases, and digital asset libraries.

Familiarity with photo/video editing software such as Adobe Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, or comparable tools.

Demonstrated graphic design skills with experience creating digital marketing assets and ad creative.

Proficiency in email marketing platforms (specifically Klaviyo) and digital advertising tools (e.g., Google Ads, Square, Meta Ads Manager).

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Strong visual sense and an appreciation for high-quality product presentation.

Interest in gems, minerals, fossils, jewelry, natural history, art, or luxury goods is a plus.

A passion for visual storytelling, curiosity about natural history and the gem and mineral world, and a meticulous approach to digital merchandising will make you especially successful in this role.

jobs.title: Field Beauty Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

It is a great time to join CVS/pharmacy, the retail division of CVS Health, as America’s leading retail pharmacy with more than 8,000 stores and continuing to grow. As a company, CVS is committed to providing our customers with the newest in beauty- but we focus on purpose-driven service that puts the customer and their needs first. This is highlighted by our purpose-led CVS Beauty Mark initiative, designed to create new industry standards for post-production alteration of beauty imagery and encourage and promote authentic beauty imagery.  
As a Beauty Sales Coordinator, you are excited about beauty and can help your teams translate their passion for beauty into sales and exceptional customer experiences. You will be the curator of the ultimate beauty experience in stores, ensuring all Beauty Sales Consultants have the skills and tools they need to drive sales growth, maximize customer engagement and elevate the execution of product promotions and events. This position is tasked with ensuring that all CVS Beauty Experience & Service initiatives and programs are consistently executed within your area.  
Beauty Sales Coordinators report directly to the Senior Advisors of Beauty in their Division.  
Essential Functions:

Sales Driver- Selling: (60%)  

* Acts as the primary advocate for driving the entire Beauty & Personal Care business in each of their assigned doors.
* Leads the elevation of service by empowering all Beauty Sales Consultants to become beauty experts and increase Beauty & Personal Care multi-brand and category selling.
* Works closely with Store Management and Senior Advisors of Beauty (SAB) to set coaching priorities for the Beauty Sales Consultants teams to maximize sales in B&PC.
* Creates and monitors individual sales plans for each Beauty Sales Consultant to achieve monthly BE&S budget goals.
* Understands critical business drivers and uses business acumen to identify the needs of the local customer and utilizes this knowledge to drive sales in the store
* Adheres to regular, consistent store visit cadence and works directly with store teams.
* Creates comprehensive event execution plans that focus on driving featured product sales and promptly communicates event recaps.

Staff Development & Education: (20%)  

* Owns the execution of brand/product education for all Beauty Sales Consultants and seeks out opportunities to expose the team to any additional learnings that will help drive sales.
* Must ensure all Beauty Sales Consultants complete required Beauty Experience & Service required training courses and ensure attendance in all field training sessions.
* Cultivates an environment of continuous learning for all Beauty Sales Consultants.
* Owns all events and education dissemination for Beauty Sales Consultants - which they leverage to increase traffic & drive sales for total CVS beauty.
* Works closely with SAB to set coaching priorities and goals for their Beauty Sales Consultants teams.

  
Execution Support: (20%)  

* Supports Store Leadership in recruiting & hiring Beauty Sales Consultants for their assigned stores.
* Reviews and analyzes business performance & sales results to inspire teamwork to achieve sales goals.
* Communicates business & operational opportunities to store & district partners through consistent, thorough recaps.
* Instills the initiative to use all Retail technology provided, focusing on sales, education, and customer engagement.
* Reinforces & supports CVS Beauty business and marketing objectives with Beauty Sales Consultants and store teams.
* Ensure that all CVS tester sanitation, hazardous waste disposal, and product demo tool cleansing policies are executed in a timely and compliant manner.
* Coordinates & executes all corporate beauty events- GWP’s, Beauty Box events, and vendor-specific events. Accountable for event maximization by pre-planning inventory, team scheduling, sample distribution, and store team awareness.

Why You’ll Love Working Here!  

* Exposure to the latest and greatest product in the industry through brand interaction, educational seminars, and more!
* Gratis. Everyone loves free samples! You will be overwhelmed with the number of great products you get to take home and try out.
* Fun-filled days at regional conferences. Brand partners and other colleagues will present and discuss new and upcoming products and educate on various initiatives.
* You will be helping our customers on their path to better health.

**Required Qualifications**  
  
Education/Experience:  

* 1-2 years in a leadership/supervisory position in a service-driven environment.
* 1-2 years of Beauty & Personal Care selling experience.
* Strong passion for beauty
* Ability to educate, coach, and develop a team.

  
Language Skills:  

* Ability to read, write, and interpret general business information.
* Ability to effectively communicate with and present information to customers, vendors, buyers, peers, and all levels of management.
* In specific CVS districts, we require bilingual beauty teams that can speak to customers in both English and Spanish.

  
Mathematical Skills:  

* Basic math functions such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
* Able to use a calculator and calculate percentages and ratios.
* Must be able to make change in American monetary units.
* Ability to utilize Microsoft Excel spreadsheets to organize, review and evaluate data.

Reasoning Ability:  

* Work independently, with minimal supervision.
* Must be able to anticipate and solve problems

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - North Jersey
jobs.description:
**Position Purpose:**

The Outside Sales Representative (OSR) is responsible for driving incremental sales growth and profitability through account relationships, specifically focusing on Complex Business Expansion and new business development. The OSR will monitor key performance indicators for assigned professional customers and meet or exceed Sales and Margin performance to plan by working with the Pro Sales Manager. OSRs leverage data, customer insights, and review pertinent Pro customer satisfaction results to understand customers' perspectives and use the information to drive local decisions and strategies to improve competitive position and drive capability adoption.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* 10% - Cross-Functional Collaboration - Participate in district/regional meetings as needed. Communicate weekly activities with Pro Sales Manager.
* 60% - Cultivate Net New Sales Relationships - Utilize local community events to continuously represent The Home Depot Pro brand and drive new business and grow Complex Business expansion. Sell all products and services available from the enterprise, including Commercial Credit options, Volume Pricing Program, delivery, will call pickup, and website ordering. Produce new account revenue in line with current organization through individual targets/quotas. Partner with Inside Sales Support Representative as a daily point of contact to drive an end-to-end quoting, ordering, and transaction experience for customers. Establish effective partnerships with assigned customers by completing in-person sales appointments. Develop strategies focused on expanding customer base within defined sales territory. Drive incremental sales growth by cultivating business relationships with assigned customer portfolios and prospecting to drive incremental sales growth.
* 10% - Customer Relationship Management - Utilize Salesforce to plan future sales call activity, manage ongoing customer communications, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* 20% - Sales Prospecting - Conduct initial customer meetings and build relationships, selling The Home Depot value proposition and win opportunity to quote materials. Prospect for new business leveraging leads provided by internal Sales Development team as well as leads generated in the field via existing customer relationships, stores, and within the community.

* This Position typically reports to the Pro Sales Manager
* This Has 0 Direct Reports

* Typically requires overnight travel 20% to 50% of the time.

* Most of the time is spent sitting in the same position or standing/walking or there is some requirement to lift or handle material or equipment of moderate weight (8-20 pounds).

**Working Conditions:**

* Typically in a comfortable environment but with regular exposure to factors such as temperature extremes, moving machinery, loud noise, and fumes that cause noticeable discomfort or a moderate risk of accident or illness.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Must be 18 years of age or older
* Must be legally permitted to work in the United States

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite
* 5 years of professional work experience
* 2 years account management/sales management experience
* 2 plus years home improvement or home building industry experience
* Successful professional growth in a high-paced retail environment
* Demonstrates a strong ability to create and cultivate an active network of relationships both inside and outside the organization
* Ability to leverage relationships to accomplish sales and profitability goals
* Deep understanding of Pro customer needs with a focus on fulfilling 100% of their product, credit, and performance requirements
* Determine how each customer would prefer to be served and tailor communications and customer-facing activities appropriately
* Strong leadership and negotiation skills; ability to persuade or influence others
* Excellent communication skills (verbal, written) and able to communicate globally

* The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.

* None

* Being Resilient
* Persuades
* Builds Networks
* Communicates Effectively
* Customer Focus
* Drives Results
