jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a key member of Fortinet’s sales organization, responsible for driving growth within an assigned territory. In this role, you will partner closely with Field and Inside Sales Account Managers to build and execute strategies that expand new customer acquisition while strengthening existing relationships.

At Fortinet, we foster a results driven, high performance culture that rewards hard work, innovation, and excellence. Our team thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where initiative is encouraged and success is celebrated. Fortinet invests heavily in its people providing comprehensive onboarding, continuous technical and sales training, and ongoing enablement to ensure your long-term success.

As an ISR, you will collaborate with Fortinet’s reseller partners, marketing teams, and channel organizations to drive opportunities, generate pipeline, and increase revenue. You will play a pivotal role at the forefront of identifying new business opportunities and contributing to the overall success of the sales organization.

This role offers clear career advancement opportunities, empowering team members to grow within the sales organization, and recognizing top performers with career development, rewards, and increased responsibility.

Job Responsibilities

* Generate new sales opportunities through outbound calls, emails, and social media outreach

* Qualify leads and set appointments for the sales team, ensuring a steady flow of high-quality meetings and opportunities

* Create and track sales opportunities (leads, renewals, and deal registrations in Salesforce.com)

* Manage small-scale deals and renewal opportunities throughout the full sales cycle, from pre‑sale to post‑sale.

* Collaborate with sales team to strategize outreach and lead qualifications.

* Address customer satisfaction issues and requests in a timely manner and assist with customer presentations and demos

* Meet and exceed sales activity metrics designed to drive productivity and success

* Align with sales, channel, and partner teams to support overall company revenue targets

* Execute the role with professionalism and in alignment with Fortinet’s core values

* Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

Required Qualifications

* Prior experience as an Inside Sales Representative (ISR), Business Development Representative (BDR), or in a similar sales role

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

* Strong communicator with proven relationship-building skills

* Self-starter: coachable, adaptable, and growth-driven

* Proficient with Salesforce and modern prospecting tools

* Highly organized, resilient, and results-focused

* Entrepreneurial mindset with forward-thinking problem-solving

Preferred Qualifications

* Technical degree in Computer Science, Information Technology/Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field

* Background in networking, security, and/or public/private cloud (preferred)

* 1–3 years of sales or related individual contributor experience

* Experience with multi-tier distribution (Channel Sales)

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program.

Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. On target earnings for this position is expected to be $70,000 - $85,000 per year. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, and this position is also eligible for commissions based on the terms of the Sales Compensation Plan

jobs.title: Clinic Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Starling Diagnostics LLC is seeking a motivated and organized full-time Clinic Operations Coordinator to join our growing healthcare clinic in Bronx, NY. This full-time opportunity offers **$21 – $25 per hour**, depending on experience, along with **PTO, a 401(k), and growth opportunities**. This is a **full-time**, primarily on-site position with a **Monday - Friday** schedule in Bronx, NY. All hours worked must be accurately recorded, and overtime will be paid in accordance with applicable law.

**YOUR DAY-TO-DAY AS OUR CLINIC OPERATIONS COORDINATOR**

As a Clinic Operations Coordinator, you will support the Operations Director with daily clinic operations and a variety of assigned projects that help keep the organization running efficiently. You will coordinate with vendors, contractors, insurance companies, and external partners while requesting and organizing quotes for supplies, equipment, furniture, and services. Throughout the day, you will maintain operational records, trackers, schedules, and documentation, assist with staffing coordination and workforce-related administrative tasks, and follow up on outstanding items to provide leadership with status updates. You will assist with contractor documentation and routine administrative matters, support operational planning and coordination for future clinic locations, and identify operational issues that should be escalated to the appropriate leader. As the organization continues to expand, you will have opportunities to develop your healthcare operations knowledge and take on additional responsibilities over time.

**Here's what we need from you:**

* Highly organized and dependable with strong follow-through
* Proactive, motivated, and eager to learn
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable working with leadership, employees, vendors, and contractors
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Proficient with email, spreadsheets, and basic business software

Previous healthcare, operations, administrative, or coordination experience is a plus!

**WHY CHOOSE US?**

Since 2019, our team at Starling Health has demonstrated what it means to act with compassion, innovation, and community commitment. We've rapidly evolved from a small diagnostic center to a comprehensive multi-specialty medical practice serving over 10,000 patients annually. We believe that people from all populations deserve access to high-quality care, and we're proud to act as a healing hub for underserved urban communities. As we expand into new locations, we invite job seekers who share our passion for healing and making a meaningful difference in others' lives to join us.

Complete our mobile-friendly application to take the next step toward joining us as our next Clinic Operations Coordinator.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title**: Logistics Coordinator

**Location**: Hoboken, NJ

**Division:** Operations

**Department:** Supply Chain and Fulfillment

  

**About Us:**

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to operate at room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.

**Position Description**

We are seeking a dedicated and passionate Logistics Coordinator to join our QCi Supply chain and Fulfillment team. In this vital role, you will support the execution of inbound receiving and outbound shipping activities at our Hoboken, NJ location. The Logistics Coordinator will work closely with inbound and outbound transportation providers, as well as internal QCi members in our Hoboken location and other locations in the U.S. to ensure that all product movement is completed on time, accurately and efficiently in accordance with QCi business requirements. We are looking for a hands-on, highly organized Logistics Coordinator who works well in a fast paced, dynamic environment and is ready to be an enthusiastic member of the QCi team.

**Duties / Responsibilities:**

* Inbound: Daily scheduling and receiving of all shipments, including monitoring ETAs, delivery to end users within QCi, and completion of receiving transactions
* Outbound: Daily execution of all outbound shipping activities, including packing and preparing shipments, transportation mode and service level selection, shipping document preparation, coordinating and scheduling pickups with transportation providers, tendering shipments to drivers, completing shipping transactions and monitoring shipments through to delivery
* Issue Resolution: Identify and resolve inbound and outbound shipment delays, shipment exceptions and requests to modify shipment delivery requirements
* Transportation: Maintain and establish relationships with transportation providers, including up-to-date rate information, contact lists, account representatives, non-service or holiday schedules and scope of services offered
* Reporting: Daily inbound and outbound volume activity reports and quarterly transportation provider performance reports

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in logistics, transportation, shipping or supply chain operations
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Strong communication skills
* Collaborative attitude
* Strong problem-solving skill

**Additional Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with logistics systems, including shipping systems
* Experience with domestic and international shipping requirements

*Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

**Why Harvey**
==============

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

**Role Overview**
=================

The People Operations Coordinator, Onboarding supports the operational foundation of Harvey's new hire experience, running the logistics, systems, and processes that make onboarding work end-to-end — from pre-arrival travel and scheduling through document collection, system processing, and in-person facilitation on day one.
  
  
This is a hands-on coordination role that sits at the center of a fast-growing People team, partnering daily with the People Operations team and cross-functionally with People Systems, Recruiting, Benefits, Payroll, and Legal. The onboarding program is scaling quickly and still being built in places, so this person will both execute a high volume of moving pieces with precision and help improve the systems and materials as the program matures. Success in the role means every new hire's first experience with Harvey feels welcoming, organized, and seamless.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Facilitate in-person onboarding for New York–based new hire cohorts — run orientation and make sure every new hire feels welcomed and ready from day one.
* Own onboarding logistics end-to-end: coordinate administrative filing and manage orientation schedules, decks, and calendar invites.
* Process new hires accurately across our systems (Workday and related tools), with a clear eye on downstream impact to Payroll, Benefits, and IT.
* Support pre-employment and compliance processes, including background checks, right-to-work verification, and required document collection and filing across our global regions.
* Support the creation and maintenance onboarding materials — orientation slides, onboarding guides, and internal documentation — keeping content accurate as the program evolves.
* Manage new hire communications, support onboarding automations (email sequences and calendar workflows), and surface field feedback to help improve the program at scale.

**What You Have**
=================

* 1–3+ years in HR, People Operations, onboarding, event management, or a related operations or coordination role.
* Experience with an HRIS (Workday strongly preferred); familiarity with onboarding workflows a plus.
* High attention to detail and strong follow-through — you catch your own errors and close loops without being reminded.
* Flexibility and composure in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment — you adjust quickly when priorities shift and manage multiple competing tasks without dropping the ball.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills — you keep new hires informed, flag issues proactively, and can confidently own a room in front of a large cohort.
* Comfort with global context: multi-country document requirements, regional compliance differences, and coordinating calendars across time zones.

*Nice to have: prior experience at a startup or high-growth company; exposure to global HR operations or multi-entity environments; a track record of presenting or facilitating deck-based content with energy and clarity.*

**About us**
------------

Ann Taylor embodies and celebrates the spirit, heritage, and confidence of American women leading the lives they love. Since its beginnings, Ann Taylor has been committed to providing women with everything they need to feel inspired and motivated as they navigate their multifaceted lives. Our effortlessly polished styles are thoughtfully designed to go anywhere—from the office to special occasions (and everywhere in between).Discover a culture centered on empowering employees, with access to industry leaders and tools you need to expand your skills and stretch your abilities. We'll meet you at every milestone with opportunities and benefits to make life better in and outside of work (not to mention your closet). Ready to join us?

**About the role**

The ideal Production Assistant for Print and Color is a fast learner, self-driven individual who is passionate about color and the technicalities of the printing process. They will assist the Print & Color Manager with developing seasonal palettes and communicating with suppliers to ensure that both color and print are executed in accordance with original intent. They must have a keen eye for detail and outstanding organization skills.

This is an entry level job for someone looking to start their career in Production!

**The impact you can have**

Color Development Responsibilities:

* Assess lab dips and communicate color comments to our fabric mills
* Match seasonal inspiration to Pantone numbers and other corporate color standards
* Match color for printer using Ned Graphics software
* Name and number all new color standards
* Upload seasonal colors into corporate PLM system
* Make physical palettes as well as digital palettes
* Responsible for updating shared documents with recent changes in palettes
* Order ribbons for palettes and build boards for presentation
* Keep color library clean and replenished
* Ensure that art has correct color info before going into production
* Organize and file back inspirational swatches after the conclusion of each season

* Assess strike offs and communicate color and printing comments to our fabric mills
* Attend weekly CFT meetings to align with cross-functional partners on print development needs
* Prepare and submit art and color packages via email, web upload and shipping
* Maintain a current and organized print chart with details and status of all developments

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the CEO & Executive Leadership Team
jobs.description:
You are highly organized, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You anticipate needs, exercise sound judgment, and handle confidential information with discretion. You can manage competing priorities, build strong relationships across the organization, and help C-suite executives and senior leaders operate efficiently and effectively.

Reporting to the CEO, you will provide direct executive support to the CEO and the North American C-suite leadership team including the Chief Marketing & Revenue Officer and Chief Financial Officer. This role is based in New York and follows a hybrid work model, with an onsite presence as required/needed. Flexibility outside standard work hours is required to support a global executive team across time zones.

### **Your Next Challenge :**

* Coordinate complex calendars, domestic and international travel, leadership and Board meetings, events, and related logistics for multiple executives. Provide responsive support as needed outside standard business hours to accommodate executive time zone differences, executive travel, and critical business needs.
* Prepare executive meeting agendas, briefing materials, presentations, and other business documents.
* Collect, organize, and prepare information for executive meetings, leadership discussions, and external engagements.
* Track action items and ensure timely follow-through on key decisions and commitments.
* Serve as a key point of coordination between executives, employees, customers, partners, board members, and other external stakeholders.
* Handle highly confidential and sensitive information with professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment.
* Build a strong understanding of company priorities, operations, and key stakeholder relationships to anticipate executive needs, proactively identify priorities, and improve effectiveness.
* Prepare expense reports, correspondence, and other business documents.
* Partner with executives and cross-functional teams to improve efficiency, alignment, and execution.
* Exercise independent judgment to prioritize requests, resolve issues, and ensure critical business matters are addressed effectively.
* Leverage AI and other productivity tools to increase efficiency, improve quality, streamline workflows, and enhance executive support.
* Complete special projects and administrative initiatives as needed.

### **What You'll Need:**

* 5+ years of executive support experience, preferably supporting senior executives or C-suite leaders.
* Exceptional organizational, time management, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities with accuracy, attention to detail, and a high degree of responsiveness.
* Ability to provide support outside standard business hours as needed, including occasional evenings, weekends, and travel-related coordination, to support a global executive team.
* Demonstrated executive presence and the ability to interact professionally with senior executives, customers, partners, board members, vendors, and other external stakeholders, while exercising the highest levels of professionalism, discretion, integrity, and accountability.
* Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to work.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, exercise independent decision-making, and manage sensitive matters with discretion.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and collaboration tools, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Slack.
* Strong experience using business systems that support executive operations, including travel, expense, and financial management platforms such as Concur.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively leverage AI tools to increase efficiency, improve productivity, streamline administrative processes, enhance communication, and support executive effectiveness.
* Flexibility to support changing business needs and priorities.

The starting salary range for this position at time of posting is USD $118,000 - $175000 per year. Getty Images has different ranges in different locations within the US, and this range represents the starting base pay range. Actual compensation will depend on factors including but not limited to: qualifications, geographic location, skills, experience, certification, business needs, performance, and level of responsibility along with the requirements of the position. The company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any point in the future. Getty Images is committed to the health and well-being of its employees and benefits for full-time permanent employees may include participation in the company incentive program, equity, and benefits package which is inclusive of medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, paid company holidays and time off, and paid parental leave. Visit our career site to learn more about our career opportunities and Diversity & Inclusion commitments.

**There’s a story in every picture, a narrative in every frame.**

We believe in the power of visuals. As a leading visual content creator, our three brands–Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash–offer a full range of content solutions to meet the needs of any customer, whatever their size, location, or budget. Whether the goal is commercial or philanthropic, revenue-generating or society-changing, market-disrupting or headline-driving, our visuals help any brand, business, or organization communicate more effectively with their target audience and urge them to action. In other words, we know how powerful an image or video can be—and that it can move the world.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Project Coordinator supports the execution of customer orders and entry-level projects for an industrial manufacturer of motors and drives. This role serves as a key coordination point between customers, Sales, Application Engineering, Project Management, manufacturing facilities, and other stakeholders to ensure technical and commercial requirements, documentation, schedules, and deliverables are completed accurately and on time. The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, and enjoys managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Primary Responsibilities

* Coordinate customer orders and entry-level projects from order handoff through completion using established processes, schedules, and project requirements.
* Serve as a day-to-day coordination point among customers, Sales, Application Engineering, Project Management, manufacturing facilities, and other stakeholders.
* Provide customers and stakeholders with accurate technical, commercial, order status, and project documentation within established guidelines.
* Review customer purchase orders and related documentation for completeness; identify discrepancies and coordinate resolution with the appropriate resource.
* Maintain project and order information in applicable ERP, CRM, and project tracking systems.
* Track order and project milestones, documentation requirements, approvals, manufacturing dates, shipment dates, and other deliverables; communicate status and escalate risks or delays as needed.
* Coordinate technical document submissions, approvals, and customer documentation requirements with Engineering, manufacturing facilities, Sales, and Project Management.
* Support order changes, schedule updates, shipping coordination, and other project administration activities in accordance with established procedures.
* Prepare customer communications, project status reports, meeting notes, action-item logs, and other project documentation.
* Respond to customer and internal inquiries, research issues, and route technical, commercial, contractual, or schedule matters to the appropriate resource as needed.
* Support customer satisfaction through timely communication, accurate records, and consistent follow-through on assigned actions.
* Participate in project handoff, status, and coordination meetings as assigned.
* Follow applicable quality, safety, compliance, records management, and company procedures.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Education

* High School Diploma or GED; Required
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, Supply Chain, Project Management, or a related field; Preferred

Experience & Knowledge

* 0-1 year of experience in project coordination, sales support, order management, customer service, manufacturing, or a related environment
* Basic understanding of project coordination, order management, and customer service principles
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams
* Ability to learn ERP, CRM, order management, and project tracking systems
* Basic ability to read, organize, and manage technical and commercial information related to industrial products and customer orders
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Ability to prioritize multiple assignments, follow established procedures, and escalate issues appropriately
* Ability to work effectively across Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Manufacturing, and customer-facing teams in a deadline-driven environment

Travel Requirements

* Occasional travel based on business needs. Travel may include visits to company facilities, customer sites, or project locations.

About WEG Electric Corp.

WEG Electric Corp. is the largest industrial electric motor manufacturer in the Americas and one of the largest electric motor manufacturers in the world, producing more than 21 million units annually. Founded in 1961, WEG Electric Corp. operates mainly in the sector of capital goods, having five main businesses: Motors, Energy, Automation, Coatings, Transmission & Distribution, providing global solutions for electric motors, variable frequency drives, soft starters, controls,

panels, transformers, and generators. The US corporate office is in Duluth, GA, with manufacturing units in Minnesota, Indiana, and Missouri, and over 30,000 employees worldwide. Visit our website to learn more: www.weg.net

We offer a pleasant work environment, competitive compensation, and a full benefits package. To Apply: All candidates must submit an updated resume and complete our application in order to be considered for this position. Must be authorized to work in the United States. WEG Electric Corp. does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, disability, veteran status, or other protected status

At the Federal Home Loan Bank of Chicago, employees come first - that’s why we offer a highly competitive compensation and bonus package, and access to a comprehensive benefits program designed to meet the needs of our employees.

**Who we are**

FHLBank Chicago partners with our members in Illinois and Wisconsin to provide them competitively priced funding, a reasonable return on their investment in the Bank, and support for their community investment activities. We are one of 11 Federal Home Loan Banks created by Congress in 1932 as a government sponsored enterprise to support mortgage lending and community investment. We are member owned and member focused. Our members include banks, credit unions, insurance companies and CDFIs (Community Development Financial Institution).

**What it’s like to work here**

At FHLBank Chicago, we bring people together. Our regular All-Staff meetings keep employees informed and our values drive the work that we do. Our Buddy Program pairs new hires with tenured employees to guide their onboarding. Our Employee Value Proposition is honed by listening and identifying the needs and priorities of our valued employees. We volunteer and identify ways to strengthen our communities. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and culture clubs create connections around shared interests and experiences. We offer live and on-demand professional development opportunities to grow your skillset and your career.

**What You’ll do**

This role will be responsible for ensuring compliance with federal regulations and program policies as well as performing a key customer success role supporting operational processes for grants awarded through the Bank’s Affordable Housing Program (AHP) General Fund Community Investment program. The Operations Specialist will assist in optimizing processes, developing tools to streamline existing processes, and building reports.

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Increase Member engagement with AHP by providing technical assistance with AHP Online application process for Members and Sponsors.
* Support creation of new housing units and support of local organizations district-wide through review of and lifecycle support for AHP projects.
* Enhance Community Investment Operations team skillset with affordable housing finance and grant-making expertise.

**What you can expect:**

* Provide quality customer service and technical assistance to program users of the AHP related to program eligibility, project feasibility, scoring commitments, system issues and all other support related to application submission
* Provide quality customer service and technical assistance to program users, including guidance for submitting requests, supporting documentation, and ongoing certifications and/or reporting
* Perform comprehensive analysis of multi-family rental and owner-occupied projects for regulatory and programmatic compliance during the full AHP application lifecycle
* Analyze and track grant performance and disbursements of awarded funds. Build and maintain tools to create efficiencies around existing processes and procedures
* Support the reporting of operational occurrences, events, and other reportable issues related to AHP round activity in Community Investment operations, ensuring any SARs are filed as needed
* Make recommendations and updates to existing AHP General Fund program policies, procedures and user guides
* Assist with system support through data analysis, reporting, and participation in user acceptance testing
Other duties as assigned, including supporting other Community Investment programs during high volume times  

**What you’ll bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Urban Studies, Public Administration or Policy. Post graduate education may substitute for work experience.
* 2-4 years’ experience in affordable housing finance, community development, or community economic development.
* 2-4 years’ experience with direct customer success or customer service engagements.
* Familiarity with local, state, federal, and/or community development programs, grant application processes, and how they are used in various financing structures
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Access
* Working knowledge of Tableau and SQL
* Possess excellent written and verbal communications and ability to tailor messaging to different audiences
* Ability to take initiative in a fast-paced work environment, work effectively under pressure, either independently or as a member of a team.
* Cultivates strong relationships, can work across teams and departments.

**The Perks**

At FHLBank Chicago, employees come first. We offer a highly competitive compensation and bonus package, and access to a comprehensive benefits program designed to meet the needs of our employees. Our retirement program includes a 401K and Pension. Our generous PTO plan provides five weeks of vacation for new employees and 11 paid holidays per year. We offer work from home options and a casual dress code at our beautiful new space in the Old Post Office. Step into your future with us.

**Salary Range:**

$55,825.00 - $83,725.00

*The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we may also consider your experience, and other job-related factors. In addition to the base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package which can be found here:* *https://hrportal.ehr.com/fhlbc*

Axiom is the #1 alternative legal services provider globally, giving in-house legal teams on-demand access to top legal talent and lawyers - deployed when, where, and how clients need it, for up to 50% less than national law firms.

SPIFFs and other short-term incentives offer even more opportunities to be rewarded for strong performance, keeping success exciting along the way.

* **A Culture Where People Win Together**

Sales is competitive, but success at Axiom isn't a solo effort. Our BDR culture is rooted in **collaboration, teamwork, and genuine connection** - whether that's sharing what's working, celebrating each other's wins, learning from one another, or spending time together outside of the day-to-day. You'll be surrounded by teammates who want to perform at a high level and help each other succeed.

  

**REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

(NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You'll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

### **About the Job**

As a Sales Development Representative at OpenTable, you will play a key role in driving business growth by identifying and generating new restaurant partnerships across the US. Based out of our Chicago office in a hybrid capacity, you will engage prospective clients, educate them on OpenTable's reservation and guest management solutions, and secure qualified meetings for Account Executives. Every member of our team directly impacts how restaurants thrive, empowering operators to streamline their business, enhance guest experiences, and grow their bottom line.

### **Responsibilities**

* Conduct targeted outbound prospecting via calls, emails, and professional networking to identify and engage prospective restaurant partners.
* Qualify leads based on operational needs, budget alignment, and fit, delivering highly prospective opportunities to Account Executives.
* Deliver compelling value propositions and product demonstrations tailored to unique restaurant operational pain points.
* Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, pipeline progress, and account updates within Salesforce CRM.
* Collaborate closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to strategize target accounts and optimize lead conversion rates.
* Stay knowledgeable about restaurant industry trends, market dynamics, and competitive offerings to position solutions effectively.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* 1+ years of experience in sales development, business development, or customer-facing sales roles.
* Proven track record of prospecting, qualifying leads, and meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex product values clearly.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and sales engagement tools.
* Ability to work in a hybrid capacity from our Chicago office two days per week.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in software-as-a-service (SaaS), hospitality, or restaurant technology industries.
* Familiarity with OpenTable's product platform and restaurant management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships and communicate effectively with key decision-makers and restaurant owners.
* Experience managing multi-channel outbound campaigns using modern sales technology tools (e.g., Groove).
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communication, or a related field.

### **Benefits and Perks**

* Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
* Focus on mental health and well-being:
* + Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
  + Company-paid subscription to Headspace
  + Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
* Paid parental leave
* Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
* Paid volunteer time
* Focus on your career growth:
* + Development Dollars
  + Leadership development
  + Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
* Travel Discounts
* Employee Resource Groups
* Competitive retirement and health plans

Note for MA applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this United States based role is $55,000 to $65,000 plus quarterly sales bonus.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits.

### **Work Environment & Flexibility**

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

### **Inclusion**

We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we're here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

**Reports to:** Senior Client Experience Manager

**Position Summary:**  
The Client Experience Coordinator is an essential member of the FaithWise Advisors team, responsible for delivering the accurate, timely, and caring service that makes a high-touch client journey possible. This role supports every stage of the client relationship, from onboarding and account setup to contributions, grants, and ongoing service requests, ensuring each interaction reflects FaithWise's mission and its commitment to faithful stewardship.

The Coordinator partners with advisors, the Client Experience team, and operations colleagues to process client requests, maintain CRM discipline, and keep onboarding and business development workflows moving. After a structured training period, the Coordinator becomes a primary point of contact for clients, answering calls and emails with warmth, clarity, and discretion. Success in this role requires close attention to detail, sound judgment with sensitive information, and a daily commitment to FaithWise's values of integrity, stewardship, excellence, collaboration, and curiosity.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Experience and Service Delivery**

* Answer client phone calls and emails promptly and professionally, resolving routine requests and setting clear expectations on next steps and timing.
* Process routine service requests, including address and contact updates, transfers, distributions, beneficiary and authorized-party changes, and document requests, and prepare forms for client signature.

* Support stewardship touchpoints by scheduling outreach, preparing mailings, and tracking completion, in partnership with the CX Associate.

**Client Onboarding and Business Development Support**

* Carry out onboarding steps for new investing and charitable clients: send welcome communications, collect and review documents, prepare account-opening and fund-establishment paperwork, and track each item to completion.

* Maintain an onboarding tracker so the Senior Client Experience Manager and advisors can see the status of every new relationship at a glance.

* Log client interactions, service activity, and prospect follow-up tasks in the CRM.

* Sound judgment and a clear sense of when to resolve an issue and when to escalate it.
* Strong organization, project management, and time management skills in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

* Commitment to FaithWise's mission and to serving clients with integrity, stewardship, excellence, collaboration, and curiosity.

**USGBC-CA Development Coordinator**

The Development Coordinator plays a vital role in advancing the mission of USGBC California by driving key operational, donor engagement, and business development functions across corporate sponsorships and individual giving. Reporting directly to the Chief Development Officer, this role executes sponsorship fulfillment across 10 California regions, coordinates logistics for signature fundraising events (California Green Building Conference and Green Gala), manages individual giving appeals, and supports business development for leading market initiatives. Embracing our core values of being "Rooted in Kindness" and "Humans in Service to One Another," this position ensures seamless donor stewardship and database management to support annual funding goals while building lasting relationships with both current and future partners.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities**

* **Fundraising Execution & Support:** Coordinate fundraising identification, cultivation, asks, stewardship fulfillment, and benefit tracking across fundraising initiatives, including statewide and regional funding.
* **Signature Event Fundraising Logistics:** Support event fundraising execution for statewide and regional events (ex. California Green Building Conference, Green Gala, etc.), coordinating sponsor collateral, benefit execution, and post-event funder follow-up.
* **Campaign Execution:** Coordinate administrative and digital workflows for giving programs, market transformation initiatives, and events utilizing automations and tech stack (monday, mail merge, Donorbox, etc.)
* **CRM Management & Funder Stewardship:** Coordinate and maintain strong funder data (ex. Copper CRM), process incoming gifts, run targeted appeal queries, and issue timely acknowledgment letters and tax receipts.
* **Business and Partnership Development:** Actively build relationships with both current and potential future partners, with a focus on how to implement initiatives and programs that transform the real estate industry.
* **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:** Act in service to the broader team by pulling collateral, gathering funder metrics, and supporting cross-functional initiatives with a "how can I help?" mindset.
* Other duties as assigned

**Success in this role looks like**

* **Creative Thinking:** Generate original ideas and propose innovative solutions anchored in fundraising best practices; proactively reach out to colleagues to brainstorm when encountering challenges; value diverse perspectives.
* **Time Management & Prioritization:** Plan and manage work deliverables efficiently maximizing effectiveness, coordinate multiple fundraising priorities and deadlines, and keep leadership informed while escalating potential conflicts proactively.
* **Team Mentality:** Understand organizational priorities and cross-functional workflows to support colleagues in reaching their goals without creating operational bottlenecks.
* **Empathy:** Seek to understand the needs of funders, members, and teammates, fostering compassion, awareness, and respect in every interaction.
* **Results Orientation:** Take personal responsibility for driving outcomes, maintaining flexibility and focus to adapt to new challenges and achieve funding targets.

**Qualifications/Skills**

* **Experience:** 2–3 years of hands-on fundraising, donor relations, or event sponsorship coordination experience required.
* **Technical Literacy:** Proficiency with nonprofit CRM systems and automations (Copper/Raiser's Edge), project management software, and digital marketing platforms required.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills for drafting compelling funder appeals, sponsor correspondence, and impact updates.
* **Mission & Values Alignment:** Strong dedication to climate action and sustainability, paired with a spirit of open collaboration, warmth, and active listening.

**Work Requirements**

* **Travel:** Occasional statewide travel required for major conferences, galas, and community events.
* **Physical/Mental Requirements:** Safely lift and transport event materials up to 25 lbs; stand or walk for extended intervals during events; maintain focus and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**TIME COMMITMENT & COMPENSATION:**

This is a full-time, hybrid position. Location: Los Angeles. Annual salary range is $65,000-$75,000.

We offer a full benefits package with discretionary unlimited vacation, 14 paid holidays, healthcare coverage (including vision and dental), 401k, and life insurance. We have parental leave and offer an annual bonus program while working in a flexible, hybrid structure.

Staff has the availability to attend our trainings and other industry events in our network and we also offer reimbursement for continuing education. We strive to have a work-life balance where we work to live and have regular team-building events to maintain our culture.

**ABOUT USGBC California:**

USGBC-CA is about people – Passionate, practical, and informed professionals and advocates who work together to transform California into a more sustainable region for all. USGBC-CA is the best place for anyone to learn the “why”, “who” and “how” of living sustainably, because business, as usual, is no longer an option. Volunteers and members believe in a sustainable built environment, gaining education, being exposed to innovation, and taking impactful action.

new_jobs.title: Inclusion Concierge Program Specialist (Circles of Support & Disability Services)
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**

This position is grant-funded for an initial 18-month term. The Kelsey may seek continued funding for the position, but employment beyond 18 months is not guaranteed.

The Inclusion Concierge Program Specialist brings specialized disability expertise to The Kelsey’s Resident Services program, grounded in experience supporting adults with a range of disabilities and support needs, including people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). A primary focus of this role is launching and strengthening The Kelsey’s Circles of Support practice for residents with higher or more complex support needs, co-facilitating Circles alongside Inclusion Concierge to strengthen residents’ natural and formal supports while centering their goals, choices, and self-determination.

The Program Specialist also serves as a disability services and benefits resource for residents and the Inclusion Concierge team, bringing deeper knowledge of disability systems, benefits, services, and community resources when more specialized support is needed. They will help strengthen disability-forward practice across Resident Services by sharing their expertise and developing practical tools, resources, and training that support current Inclusion Concierges and can be carried forward as The Kelsey opens new communities.

For this role, you will:

**Launch & Co-Facilitate Circles of Support**

* Lead the implementation and ongoing development of The Kelsey’s Circles of Support practice, incorporating input from residents and people with lived experience of disability, with a focus on residents with higher or more complex support needs.
* Partner with Inclusion Concierge to identify residents who may benefit from a facilitated Circle of Support and co-facilitate the process alongside the resident’s IC.
* Help residents identify, build, and strengthen their Circle of Support, including family, friends, neighbors, community connections, service providers, and others the resident chooses to involve.
* Facilitate accessible, resident-directed Circle conversations that keep the resident’s goals, preferences, communication needs, choices, and self-determination at the center while helping their network strengthen communication and work toward resident-identified goals
* Use Circles proactively to identify gaps in support, strengthen natural supports that complement formal and paid services, reduce isolation, foster interdependence, and build stronger networks that contribute to residents’ well-being and housing stability.
* Develop practical tools and processes for documenting, revisiting, and strengthening Circles so the practice can be sustained and expanded across current and future Kelsey communities.

**Provide Disability-Forward Expertise & Specialized Support**

* Bring specialized knowledge and experience in disability-forward support, with particular expertise in supporting adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD).
* Work alongside residents and their Inclusion Concierge when more specialized disability expertise would strengthen support, while the IC remains the resident’s primary Resident Services contact.
* Bring person-centered and disability-forward practices—including self-determination, supported decision-making, dignity of risk, natural supports, and interdependence—to resident support and planning.
* Help residents and ICs navigate more complex support needs, including identifying gaps in existing supports and exploring additional formal or natural supports that align with the resident’s goals and preferences.
* Participate in resident case conferences and other collaborative planning as needed, bringing disability-specific knowledge and helping identify when needs are best addressed by outside providers or services.

**Strengthen Benefits & Disability Systems Navigation**

* Maintain strong, current knowledge of benefits, services, and systems available to adults with disabilities locally, regionally, statewide, and federally, including Regional Center services, IHSS, SSI/SSDI, Medi-Cal and Medicare, HCBS, transportation, employment supports, and other disability-specific resources.
* Help residents understand and navigate benefits and services they may be eligible for, particularly when needs are complex, services are interrupted, or additional support is needed beyond a routine referral.
* Serve as a resource to Inclusion Concierge when deeper systems knowledge is needed, helping identify additional options and pathways while ICs continue to make referrals and maintain ongoing relationships with residents and their service partners.
* Build relationships with disability organizations, public agencies, Regional Centers, benefits resources, service providers, and other community partners to stay connected to available resources and emerging opportunities for residents.
* Develop and maintain practical benefits and resource information that can be used by residents and Inclusion Concierge across The Kelsey’s communities.

**Strengthen & Share Disability-Forward Inclusion Concierge Practice**

* Translate lessons from Circles of Support, disability services navigation, and direct resident work into practical tools and resources that strengthen The Kelsey’s Resident Services program, including a clear, replicable framework that other inclusive communities can adapt.
* Support recruitment, training, and retention of volunteers who support Resident Services programming and residents across The Kelsey’s communities, building a pipeline for future growth.
* Partner with Resident Services leadership to identify opportunities to deepen disability-forward practices and incorporate effective approaches into the broader Inclusion Concierge model.
* Develop and support training for current and new Inclusion Concierges on Circles of Support, disability services and systems, person-centered support, and other disability-forward practices.
* Provide backup Inclusion Concierge s

new_jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This is a high-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

It is a focused top-of-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full-cycle sales role.

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection-handling, and territory-management skills before furthering their sales career.

***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in San Francisco, CA)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow-ups, account research, and multi-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability - you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative - you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

**What success looks like**

In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling - whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market role.

**Why join Rippling**

* You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies - not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more
* You’ll join a fast-paced, high-performance sales environment with strong coaching, clear goals, and room to grow
* You’ll be part of a collaborative SDR team that values healthy competition, accountability, and continuous improvement
You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data  

**Additional Information**

Duties Description Reporting to the Program Analyst 2, this role will assist with the administration of grant awards issued by the Community Grants Reinvestment Fund at the Office of Cannabis Management. The Community Grants Reinvestment Fund was established by the Marihuana Regulation and Taxation Act. The Fund issues grants to qualified non-profits serving communities disproportionately affected by prior federal and state drug policies in order to redress a wide range of community needs. The incumbent will assist in the administration of Requests for Applications, review and process grant applications, develop and process contracts through the approval process, and manage and process requests for reimbursement and progress reports.
  
  
Duties include, but may not be limited to:
  

* Assist OCM teams on the development of application criteria and process management for Requests For Applications (RFA).
* Conduct application reviews using the electronic application system.
* Compile and synthesize information needed for program management and identify trends and common roadblocks for grant recipients to be successful.
* Evaluate and improve quality control and quality assurance procedures for efficient and accurate management of applications, contracts, reimbursement claims, and progress reports.
* After contract approvals, review claims submitted electronically by awardees for reimbursement and payments to ensure compliance with applicable guidelines and contract terms for each grant program.
* Organize, track, and process documentation and claims for reimbursement submitted by grant awardees in the electronic grants management system, draft reports for OCM management on grant progress.
* Maintain up-to-date spreadsheets and analytic systems to ensure accurate and timely information is readily available.
* Communicate with grant awardees to resolve questions related to the submission of reports and claims for reimbursement, including obtaining additional supporting documentation as needed, and encouraging submission of claims for reimbursement and proposals, as directed by grant timeline.
* Support special projects and initiatives for OCM grant programs.
* Perform other related duties as directed by the Director or other OCM leadership.

Minimum Qualifications Six years of experience where your major job responsibilities included one of the following: accounting and auditing; investigating and/or inspecting regulated entities and facilities; interpreting and explaining policies, rules, regulations, or laws to organizations, government or corporate officials, or individuals; policy analysis and research; surveillance; quality assurance that included evaluating whether projects met/are meeting requirements that included risk assessment; providing professional level economic development products or services; community outreach which included vulnerable populations; negotiating and/or approving contracts or agreements with suppliers, distributors, federal or state agencies, or other administrative control processes.
  
  
Substitution: An associate degree may substitute for two years of experience; a bachelor’s degree may substitute for four years of experience; a master’s degree may substitute for five years of experience; and a doctorate may substitute for six years of experience.
  
  
NOTE: IN ORDER TO AWARD THE PROPER CREDIT FOR WORK EXPERIENCE, RESUMES MUST INCLUDE MONTH AND YEAR FOR START AND END DATES. IF ANY OF THIS EXPERIENCE IS LESS THAN FULL TIME YOU MUST INDICATE THE AVERAGE NUMBER OF HOURS WORKED PER WEEK.

Additional Comments • Travel may be required (approximately 10%), including during evening and weekends, depending on mission and assignment.
  

* Possession and maintenance of a valid Driver’s License issued by the NYS Department of Motor Vehicle is required or otherwise demonstrate the capacity to meet the transportation needs of the job.

  
The Office of Cannabis Management (OCM) is an equal opportunity employer, and we recognize that diversity in our workforce is critical to fulfilling our mission. We encourage applicants from all communities to apply. For a full version of OCM’s EEO/AA statement and benefits of joining OCM, please visit: About | Office of Cannabis Management (ny.gov). ### **Description**

ELEMIS are looking for a Retail Marketing Coordinator to join our Marketing team. Reporting to the Director of Channel Marketing, this role is responsible for the **day-to-day execution and optimization of digital merchandising across ELEMIS North America retail and ecommerce channels**, including Sephora, Ulta Beauty, Amazon, Department Stores, QVC and other key partners.

You will ensure that ELEMIS shows up accurately, consistently and compellingly across retailer digital touchpoints—from new product launches and PDP content to navigation, search, promotions and evergreen optimization. Working closely with the North America Channel & Brand Marketing team, Global Marketing, Creative and retailer partners, this individual will help create a seamless consumer journey that supports product discovery, conversion and sell-through.

This role will suit someone who is organized, digitally savvy and comfortable working directly within retailer platforms and brand portals, with experience managing multiple launches, assets and deadlines simultaneously.

### **What You Will Do:**

**Digital Merchandising & Ecommerce Execution:**

* Own day-to-day digital merchandising execution across wholesale and ecommerce partners, including Sephora, Ulta Beauty, Amazon, Department Stores, QVC and other priority accounts.
* Manage NPF process, retailer PDP setup, maintenance and optimization, including product imagery, copy, claims, videos, enhanced content, ratings/reviews, assets and other conversion-driving content.
* Upload and manage content directly within retailer brand portals and PIM/PXM platforms, including Sephora and Ulta Beauty.
* Coordinate Amazon Carousel, A+ and other enhanced content, ensuring assets are delivered and implemented as a complete consumer journey.
* Support digital readiness for new product launches, assortment changes, packaging transitions, discontinuations and promotional moments.
* Conduct ongoing site QA across retailer platforms, identifying and resolving issues related to product information, imagery, pricing, promotions, links, navigation and overall brand presentation.
* Identify opportunities to continuously optimize the digital shelf, including search, navigation, filters, cross-sell/link-sell, product recommendations and content sequencing.
* Maintain and update evergreen digital assets, ensuring expired or outdated content is removed and retailer sites consistently reflect the latest approved brand materials.
* Monitor retailer digital best practices and competitive activity to identify opportunities to improve discoverability, conversion and the overall consumer experience.

**Launch & Asset Management:**

* Maintain merchandising calendars, launch trackers, asset requirements and implementation timelines across North America channels.
* Liaise closely with Global Marketing to ensure North America retailer requirements are captured early, incorporated into global briefs and delivered against regional deadlines.
* Manage regional asset delivery for NPD, campaigns, core programs and seasonal moments, ensuring retailer-specific requirements are met.
* Build and manage Creative briefs for retailer-specific digital assets and coordinate feedback, approvals and final delivery.
* Support reporting and post-launch analysis to identify learnings and opportunities for future optimization.

**Spa Marketing Support:**

* Support the North America Spa business with ongoing marketing execution across digital and print touchpoints.
* Brief Spa-specific digital and print assets into the Creative team and coordinate delivery through approval and production.
* Maintain and refresh the Spa landing page on ELEMIS.com quarterly, ensuring content, imagery and information remain current.

* Partner closely with Relationship Managers, product specialists and Enterprise teams to qualify opportunities, develop account strategies and progress revenue opportunities with key stakeholders and decision makers

* Strong presentation and communication skills

**We’d love to see:**

  

* Prior experience or knowledge of the Bloomberg product suite.

Amazon Ads helps brands and agencies reach customers through one of the world's largest programmatic advertising platforms. **Who we are**

FHLBank Chicago partners with our members in Illinois and Wisconsin to provide them competitively priced funding, a reasonable return on their investment in the Bank, and support for their community investment activities. We are one of 11 Federal Home Loan Banks created by Congress in 1932 as a government sponsored enterprise to support mortgage lending and community investment. We are member owned and member focused. Our members include banks, credit unions, insurance companies and CDFIs (Community Development Financial Institution).

**What it’s like to work here**

At FHLBank Chicago, we bring people together. Our regular All-Staff meetings keep employees informed and our values drive the work that we do. Our Buddy Program pairs new hires with tenured employees to guide their onboarding. Our Employee Value Proposition is honed by listening and identifying the needs and priorities of our valued employees. We volunteer and identify ways to strengthen our communities. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and culture clubs create connections around shared interests and experiences. We offer live and on-demand professional development opportunities to grow your skillset and your career.

**What You’ll do**

This role will be responsible for ensuring compliance with federal regulations and program policies as well as performing a key customer success role supporting operational processes for grants awarded through the Bank’s Affordable Housing Program (AHP) General Fund Community Investment program. The Operations Specialist will assist in optimizing processes, developing tools to streamline existing processes, and building reports.

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

**What you’ll bring:**

* 2-4 years’ experience in affordable housing finance, community development, or community economic development.
* 2-4 years’ experience with direct customer success or customer service engagements.

$55,825.00 - $83,725.00
